Here is a python code to generate a palindrome of length at least 255:

```python
import random

def generate_palindrome(n):
    half = n // 2
    chars = 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789'
    first_half = ''.join(random.choice(chars) for _ in range(half))
    if n % 2 == 0:
        second_half = first_half[::-1]
    else:
        second_half = first_half[:-1][::-1]
    return first_half + second_half

palindrome = generate_palindrome(256)
print(palindrome)
```
This code generates a random string of length half the desired palindrome, then appends its reverse to itself (or its reverse minus one character if the length is odd). The resulting string will be a palindrome of the desired length.
